chain.note: Columns 5 and 6 are the previous/next node and are self-consistent across every exported row, which is the evidence for reading them as a chain.

proven: map column 1 is the map id, column 2 the level requirement and column 6 the total star count (12), matching the live 20-stage map screenshot.
mapevents column 1 is the node id, column 8 the node name, column 13 the event kind (monster/...), columns 5/6 the chain.
unverified: Remaining column meanings are not proven and must not be guessed.
Player progress, owned stars, chest state and fight results come from the server.
Battle simulation itself is not implemented.
